summary: Penalty when a task is not fulfilled at its sequence_order.
businessRules: Soft enforcement of sequence_order; relations outrank and disable this.

sequence_order_penalty defines: Specify the penalty to be applied if a task is not fulfilled at its requested jobs.sequence_order. This penalty is ineffective if jobs.sequence_order is not provided. The default value is 10000.
Must stay consistent with: jobs.sequence_order. Changes here may require validation of those fields.
This is a soft constraint. Violations are penalized but don't make solutions infeasible.
Zero means no penalty/cost; larger values increase incentive to avoid violation.
Optional field. Omitting uses solver's default behavior (no penalty).
testingGuidance: Behavioral: lower to let the solver reorder for efficiency.
